description: Creates a document by filling a stored template, or ad-hoc html, with data: a PDF or image, or DOCX, PPTX or PDF from Word and PowerPoint templates. Returns the render with status and download_url; for an image (png, jpg or webp) up to 2 MB the result also carries the picture itself, so look at what you made before handing it on (a PDF comes as its link). Use it to make a document from data; to turn an existing office file into a PDF, use convert_to_pdf. Stored templates render their published version, so one whose published_version is null fails with template_not_found. Every call is a new render: a live key or a signed-in agent consumes units, a test key is free (watermarked on the Free plan). A render that fails returns status failed and an error with code and message; validate_template finds most causes beforehand. With einvoice the PDF becomes a ZUGFeRD / Factur-X e-invoice built from data._invoice (check the block with check_invoice first): the render then carries einvoice, the validator's report, and a refused invoice names the fields and rules to fix. The link expires at expires_at; get_render issues a fresh one.

data.description: Values for the template, shaped as get_template_schema describes; leave out when it needs none

display_check.description: What a value of the XML that the PDF does not show does: a warning in the report (default) or a failed render

flavour.description: One specification under two names; the default factur-x and zugferd make the same file

profile.description: en16931 (default) carries the whole European standard; basic is the smallest full invoice and is refused between two French businesses

xml.description: both also stores the XML as a file of its own, linked as einvoice.xml_url

einvoice.description: Makes the PDF a ZUGFeRD / Factur-X e-invoice whose XML is built from data._invoice: true for the defaults, an object to choose, false to switch off what the template declares. PDF only; live renders from the Starter plan, test keys on Free make 20 marked ones a day

engine.description: Template language of html, when it contains expressions to fill from data

filename.description: Name of the file behind download_url, e.g. invoice-2026-0042.pdf

html.description: A complete HTML document to render instead of a stored template, up to 5 MB

locale.description: BCP 47 tag for helpers and translations, e.g. de-DE

output.description: Left out, the template decides: PDF for PDF templates and html, its image format for image templates, its default output for Word and PowerPoint templates. Word templates render docx or pdf, PowerPoint templates pptx or pdf

template.description: Slug or tpl_ id of a stored template; pass this or html

wait.description: Most renders are finished when the call returns; true also waits for one that continues in the background, false returns it as it is (queued or rendering) to check later with get_render

name: render

accessibility.description: The PDF/UA-1 verdict, when the template declares it

download_url.description: Signed link to the file; null until the render succeeded

einvoice.description: The e-invoice report, when the render made one

expires_at.description: When download_url stops working; get_render issues a fresh one

template.description: The template and version rendered; null for html and conversions

title: Render a document
